jobs.title: VP – Senior DevOps Engineer (GitHub SME) (Maharashtra)
jobs.description: This job is with MSCI, an inclusive employer and a member of myGwork – the largest global platform for the LGBTQ business community. Please do not contact the recruiter directly. Your Team Responsibilities: The DevOps Platform Engineering team is responsible for building, operating, and evolving the engineering platforms, developer workflows, and self-service capabilities that enable engineering teams across MSCI to deliver software securely, reliably, and at scale. As part of the MSCI Core DevOps Engineering team, you will help define and evolve the future of software delivery and developer enablement across the organization. This includes ownership of CI/CD platforms, engineering workflows, cloud-native platforms, internal developer tooling, and self-service capabilities built on technologies such as GitHub, Azure DevOps, Kubernetes, and Backstage. The team defines and maintains engineering standards, golden paths, reusable workflows, platform abstractions, and governance models that product and engineering teams adopt to accelerate delivery while maintaining consistency, security, compliance, and operational excellence. This team operates as a software engineering organization focused on platform capabilities and developer experience - building internal products, APIs, automation, and integrations that shape how engineering teams build, deploy, operate, and support software across MSCI. Your Key Responsibilities: Architect and implement reusable CI/CD frameworks, GitHub Actions workflows, templates, and platform abstractions that standardize software delivery across the organization, packaged as golden paths that stay flexible for diverse engineering use cases. Drive enterprise DevOps and SDLC standardization initiatives and engineering best practices. Design and build internal platform capabilities, APIs, automation services, and integrations across GitHub, Azure DevOps, Backstage, cloud services, and internal systems. Partner closely with Security, Cloud Engineering, Infrastructure, Risk, and Application Engineering teams to embed governance, compliance, and operational controls directly into engineering workflows and platform capabilities. Contribute to the long-term evolution of MSCI's internal engineering platform strategy, developer experience initiatives, and platform modernization roadmap. Support and evolve production-grade engineering platforms through SRE practices such as monitoring, incident response, and capacity planning, keeping them reliable and resilient at scale. Guide engineering teams on platform adoption, CI/CD modernization, developer workflows, and engineering best practices. Your skills and experience that will help you excel: Required Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field with 8 years of experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps Engineering, Developer Platform Engineering, or related software engineering roles. Strong software engineering mindset with hands-on experience building developer platform capabilities such as automation, APIs, internal tooling, and reusable workflows, including work on an internal developer platform or portal (Backstage or equivalent). Deep expertise with SCM tools and CI/CD tooling such as GitHub (preferred), Azure DevOps, and/or GitLab, including repositories, CI/CD pipelines, reusable workflows/templates, permissions, and platform integrations. Experience designing reusable CI/CD frameworks and standardized engineering workflows, and driving platform standardization and enablement across multiple teams. Strong understanding of SDLC architecture, software delivery workflows, source control governance, branching strategies, release engineering, and developer enablement practices. Strong programming and scripting experience in one or more languages such as Go, Java, or TypeScript. Proven experience building and consuming REST APIs, webhooks, and event-driven integrations. Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud-native application delivery patterns. Experience embedding governance, compliance, and security controls into engineering workflows, partnering with Security and Risk teams (e.g., DevSecOps, policy-as-code, governance automation). Robust cross-functional collaboration and communication skills, with a track record of partnering across security, cloud, infrastructure, and engineering teams and mentoring engineers on platform adoption and best practices. Strong operational mindset with experience supporting production-grade engineering platforms and developer tooling. Nice to Have Hands-on experience with Backstage specifically. Experience building self-service engineering workflows and developer enablement platforms. Experience with platform observability, engineering metrics, and developer productivity initiatives. Experience with GitOps frameworks. Familiarity with frontend technologies such as React and TypeScript for platform UI/tooling development. Experience working within large-scale enterprise platform modernization or engineering transformation initiatives. Agentic SDLC experience and AI-native development Hands-on experience designing and operating cloud-native platforms in Azure and/or GCP. jobs.title: Climate Data Transformation and AI Specialist
jobs.job_title: Climate Data Transformation and AI Specialist
jobs.description:
MSCI Inc. is seeking a Climate Data Transformation and AI Specialist in Maharashtra, India. The role focuses on automating data processes using AI, Python, and modern data practices to enhance climate data research for global companies. Responsibilities include AI enablement, data operations, quality assurance, process improvement, and stakeholder collaboration. Candidates should have 4–7 years of relevant experience and a strong technical background in data science or related fields.
Your Team Responsibilities The Climate Data and Content team is responsible for research and assessment of carbon footprint and climate-related business initiatives for approximately 14,000 companies globally. We are evolving our operating model — shifting from manual, document-heavy workflows to intelligent, scalable, and auditable data processes powered by AI and automation. This role sits at the heart of that transformation.


We are looking for a technically strong data professional who can serve as an AI enabler within the team — someone who builds tools, automates workflows, and leverages Python, generative AI, and modern data operations practices in day-to-day work.


Your Key Responsibilities
AI Enablement & Automation

Act as the team's internal AI champion — identify automation opportunities, prototype solutions, and drive adoption of AI tools across daily workflows
Build and maintain Python scripts to automate repetitive data collection, transformation, QA, and reporting tasks
Integrate LLM-based tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT) into operational workflows for document extraction, content classification, and anomaly detection
Design AI-friendly data collection methodologies that convert unstructured disclosures into structured, machine-readable formats at scale
Validate AI-generated outputs, understand model limitations, and maintain human-in-the-loop accountability

Data Operations & Quality Assurance

Own end-to-end data collection cycles — sourcing, processing, and validating climate and ESG data from company disclosures, vendor feeds, and public filings
Design and implement multi-layer QA frameworks, rule-based checks, and anomaly detection logic to ensure data accuracy and consistency
Develop and maintain operational dashboards, trackers, and reference systems to support SLA tracking and coverage monitoring
Identify and resolve data integrity issues, coordinating with vendors, internal analysts, and technology teams as needed

Process Improvement & Documentation

Identify opportunities to simplify, standardise, and scale existing workflows through tooling and automation
Develop SOPs, process documentation, and knowledge-base articles to ensure audit-readiness and scalable knowledge transfer
Contribute to working groups and cross-functional projects aimed at expanding data coverage and operational capacity

Stakeholder Collaboration

Partner with Research, Product, and Technology teams to align on data requirements and translate business needs into technical solutions
Train and support analysts in adopting new tools, scripts, and AI-assisted workflows

Communicate clearly with internal and external stakeholders on data methodology, process changes, and query resolution
Your Skills And Experience That Will Help You Excel
Education
